integrity: All claims are supported by an analytic proof; supplementary standard-library checker has been run. No independent external audit or field calibration is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Noiseless equally spaced samples of two specific no-input loss mechanisms; no claim about general biphasic mechanisms, background inputs, noisy sampling, or parameter degeneracy. The qualitative five-point rank distinction follows classical exponential-sum theory; the quantitative log-curvature bound is the stated contribution. A related 1999 study was available by abstract only; historical priority remains provisional.
title: A quantitative log-curvature gap separates biphasic DNA loss from relaxing removal
